notes.title: Welcome!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings from everyone here at Shadow Shrimp Studio! [/b]


[u]Who are we and why are we making a VR game:[/u]

We are a small team based out of the Midwest who wanted to make a VR game that took us back to the time of being children and using our imagination to make our toys come to life. We think that VR gives a special and intimate gaming experience which lends itself to fond memories and fun games. 

[b]So what is the deal with [i]Batteries Included[/i]:[/b]

Batteries Included is a very special game for us. It is an amalgamation of all what we found special during childhood. We wanted to actually show how we felt our toys came alive with personalities unique to each type of toy. At it's core, the game is a reverse on tower defense with you, the player, guiding goblins into a castle. You do this by blasting them out of toy cannons, putting down block hexes, breaking down drawbridges, and many more ways. We hope you love it as much as we do.

For a little history on the game and to see how far we have come follow us on twitter @ShadowShrimpDev and read some of our behind the scenes blog posts on https://shadowshrimpstudios.blogspot.com/

Cordially,
Devin Good, Lead Designer for Shadow Shrimp Studio LLC
